items.text: GPT-5.6 is now out. We've been evaluating the model family on the Box AI Complex Work eval, which tests the model with the Box AI Agent on a variety of extremely hard tasks using enterprise document sets. Sol is a big step up from GPT-5.5, especially on complex data-oriented tasks that require deep reasoning and analysis, and the gains concentrate exactly where enterprise work is hardest.
